title: The Eyewitness
sentences: We know what Vesuvius looked like because a teenager wrote it down.
Pliny the Younger was seventeen, staying across the bay at Misenum.
He saw a huge cloud rise into the sky, shaped like a pine tree, with a tall trunk and spreading branches.
Later he described falling ash, and a darkness like a closed, unlit room.
About twenty-five years later, he wrote it all down in letters to the historian Tacitus.
Volcanologists still call this kind of eruption Plinian.
caption:
We know what Vesuvius looked like because a 17-year-old wrote it down.
